examples.japanese: {器具|きぐ}を{滅菌|めっきん}する。
{哺乳|ほにゅう}{瓶|びん}は{使用|しよう}{前|まえ}に{滅菌|めっきん}してください。
examples.english: Please sterilize baby bottles before use.

examples.japanese: {手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}では{全|すべ}ての{道具|どうぐ}が{厳密|げんみつ}に{滅菌|めっきん}{処理|しょり}されている。
examples.english: All instruments in the operating room are rigorously sterilized.

notes:
Refers to the complete destruction of all microorganisms including bacteria, viruses, and spores. Stricter than {殺菌|さっきん} (disinfection), which only reduces the number of pathogens.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滅菌|めっきん}{処理|しょり}: sterilization treatment
- {滅菌|めっきん}{済|ず}み: sterilized (done)
- {高圧|こうあつ}{滅菌|めっきん}: autoclave sterilization
- {滅菌|めっきん}ガーゼ: sterile gauze

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {殺菌|さっきん}: disinfection, pasteurization — kills or reduces harmful bacteria but does not eliminate all microorganisms
- {消毒|しょうどく}: disinfection, sanitization — a broader term for cleaning to remove pathogens; used in everyday contexts like hand sanitizing
- {除菌|じょきん}: removing bacteria — commonly seen on household cleaning products; less technical than {滅菌|めっきん}
